title: clinopodium alpinum subsp. majoranifolium
intro: Clinopodium alpinum subsp. majoranifolium, commonly known as mountain calamintha, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections, due to its numerous health benefits, such as its antibacterial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of mountain calamintha include its ability to relieve coughs, colds, and sore throats, as well as its use as a carminative to ease digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of Clinopodium alpinum subsp. majoranifolium include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
